server._spawnProtectionComment: Same as spawn-protection in the server's server.properties (0 = off). Non-op players can't break or place blocks this close to the world spawn, so the bots avoid digging there.
server._viewDistanceComment: Chunks each bot loads around it. Lower = much less CPU for many bots.

ai._providerComment: auto = use Claude if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is in .env, otherwise OpenAI if OPENAI_API_KEY is. Or set "anthropic" / "openai".
ai._maxTokensComment: A cap, not a charge: you pay for the tokens actually written. Most replies are ~40 tokens; a book can need ~250.

_imposterComment: 2 secret imposters, chosen once at least minVillagers are alive. They may kill when a kill window is open (every killEveryDays Minecraft days, the first firstKillAfterDays after they were chosen; up to killsPerWindow kills), and only with nobody within witnessRadius blocks. Villagers within seeRadius of a death see it.
_societyComment: Elections start when there is no leader or the term (in Minecraft days) is over; they close when all voted or after electionMinutes real minutes.
_leaderComment: Optional elder AI (off by default): every everyMinutes during a session one bigger model reads a village summary, writes a short plan shown to every villager and posts up to 3 jobs. Roughly $0.005 a call with Sonnet (about $0.06 a 3-hour session). openaiModel is used when the provider is OpenAI.

pricing._comment: US dollars per million tokens. cacheWrite is the 5-minute cache write (1.25x input). Haiku 5.5 prices are for prompts up to 100K tokens. OpenAI prices from developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (Nov 2026).

_scheduleComment: With --scheduled (pm2), a session runs every day from start to end, UK time (summer time handled). manualMinutes = how long a session started from the website runs outside the window.
_websiteComment: Live status on the website's Bots page. url/key are read from ../manager/manager.json (the existing bot manager's website link) unless set here or in .env (CIV_WEBSITE_URL, BOT_MANAGER_KEY).

village._comment: centre null = use the world spawn point. Set {"x":..,"y":..,"z":..} to pick a spot.

chat._villagerWakesComment: Another villager's chat only wakes a bot (= one AI call) when it says the bot's name, at most villagerWakesPer5Min times in 5 minutes. Other villager chat is just remembered for the bot's next call. Players' chat always wakes it.
